approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue; the game's own Direct3D calls are drawn by a native renderer (after pgr4-native), on Vulkan with no Proton or Wine.
notes: The Xbox 360 version: Instant Action, the dual machine pistols and a bonus level the PC never got. 1.0 (source only) runs natively on Linux and the Steam Deck: up to 120 fps on the Deck and 60 fps or more in 99.8% of frames, with PC settings (field of view, frame rate limit, EchoPatch's fixes). Next: the Windows build (1.5), then F.E.A.R. Files (Extraction Point and Perseus Mandate, 360), which already builds from the same repository. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy and build it from source.
